head: a7ea562b0a019e865b6e06a4facf070b49c80bb9

source.ref: fixed by 74652ee (explicit decline) and 14284c4 (who may dismiss)

rationale: The first version of human dismissals matched decline words anywhere in any person's reply, so maintainers' questions and the PR author could silence findings.

expect.concern: The dismissal pattern matches 'intended', 'intentional' and 'acknowledged' anywhere in a reply, so 'This is not intended, good catch' or 'Is this intended?' dismisses the finding.

Any non-bot account, including the pull request's author or an outsider, can dismiss a finding by resolving its thread or replying, so the author can clear findings, critical ones included, on their own change.
